title: First Notice Letter Series Mailing Calendar, Flat-Fee Pre-Collect Programs
content:
# Mailing Calendar — Flat-Fee Pre-Collect Programs Letter Series

Every debtor submitted under a Flat-Fee Pre-Collect Programs pack receives that pack's letter series. The calendar below sets, for each pack size, how many letters the series holds, how long it runs, how soon the first letter is mailed after submission, and on which day after the first letter each later letter is mailed.

| Pack | Letters in the series | Series length (calendar days, first to last letter) | First letter mailed within (business days after submission) | Letter 2 (calendar days after letter 1) | Letter 3 | Letter 4 | Letter 5 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| First Notice 50-Unit Program | 4 | 60 | 2 | 15 | 30 | 60 | 0 (no fifth letter) |
| First Notice 150-Unit Program | 4 | 60 | 2 | 15 | 30 | 60 | 0 (no fifth letter) |
| First Notice 300-Unit Program | 5 | 75 | 2 | 15 | 30 | 45 | 75 |
| First Notice 600-Unit Program | 5 | 75 | 1 | 15 | 30 | 45 | 75 |
| First Notice 1200-Unit Program | 5 | 90 | 1 | 18 | 36 | 54 | 90 |
| First Notice 2500-Unit Program | 5 | 90 | 1 | 18 | 36 | 54 | 90 |

## How the calendar is counted

- The first letter's deadline is counted in **business days after submission**.
- Every later letter is counted in **calendar days after the first letter** — not after the previous letter and not after submission.
- A fifth-letter figure of 0 marks a series of four letters; the First Notice 50-Unit and 150-Unit Programs send no fifth letter.
- The series length runs from the first letter to the last letter, so it equals the offset of the series' final letter: 60 days on the four-letter packs, where letter 4 is the last, and 75 or 90 days on the five-letter packs, where letter 5 is the last.

## Illustration on hypothetical dates

Suppose a debtor's first letter under a First Notice 1200-Unit Program pack is mailed on a hypothetical 2 March. Counting calendar days after that first letter, letter 2 is mailed on 20 March (18 days), letter 3 on 7 April (36 days), letter 4 on 25 April (54 days) and letter 5 on 31 May (90 days), the last day of the 90-day series.

Under a First Notice 50-Unit Program pack, a first letter mailed on the same hypothetical 2 March is followed by letter 2 on 17 March (15 days), letter 3 on 1 April (30 days) and letter 4, the last, on 1 May (60 days).
